steps.prompt: Call show_threejs_scene with exactly this input, unchanged: {"height": 500, "code": "const scene = new THREE.Scene(); const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, width/height, 0.1, 100); camera.position.set(0, 1.2, 5); const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas, antialias: true}); renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio); renderer.setSize(width, height); renderer.setClearColor(0x0b0e16); const knot = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(1, 0.32, 200, 32), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0x3a7bd5, metalness: 0.4, roughness: 0.35})); scene.add(knot); const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.25, 0.06, 16, 64), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0xff8a2a})); scene.add(ring); scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.35)); const light = new THREE.PointLight(0xffffff, 40); light.position.set(3, 4, 4); scene.add(light); const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, canvas); controls.enableDamping = true; const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer); composer.addPass(new RenderPass(scene, camera)); composer.addPass(new UnrealBloomPass(new THREE.Vector2(width, height), 1.2, 0.5, 0.2)); let t = 0; function tick() { t += 0.016; knot.rotation.x += 0.004; knot.rotation.y += 0.007; ring.position.set(Math.cos(t) * 2.1, Math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.6, Math.sin(t) * 2.1); controls.update(); composer.render(); requestAnimationFrame(tick); } tick();"}
